function_declarations.name: resource-list
function_declarations.description: List all resources of a specific type from the ROM (rooms, sprites, dungeons, entrances, items, overlords)

function_declarations.name: resource-search
function_declarations.description: Search for resources by name or pattern

query.description: Search query or pattern to match

function_declarations.name: emulator-press-buttons
function_declarations.description: Presses and immediately releases one or more buttons on the SNES controller.

buttons.description: A comma-separated list of buttons to press (e.g., 'A,Right,Start').

function_declarations.name: emulator-hold-buttons
function_declarations.description: Holds down one or more buttons for a specified duration.

buttons.description: A comma-separated list of buttons to hold.

duration.description: The duration in milliseconds to hold the buttons.

function_declarations.name: emulator-get-state
function_declarations.description: Retrieves the current state of the game from the emulator.

screenshot.description: Whether to include a screenshot of the current frame.

function_declarations.name: emulator-read-memory
function_declarations.description: Reads a block of memory from the SNES WRAM.

address.description: The memory address to read from (e.g., '0x7E0010').

length.description: The number of bytes to read.

function_declarations.name: emulator-write-memory
function_declarations.description: Writes a block of data to the SNES WRAM.

address.description: The memory address to write to.

data.description: The data to write, as a hex string (e.g., 'AABBCCDD').

function_declarations.name: emulator-set-breakpoint
function_declarations.description: Set a breakpoint in the emulator to pause execution at a specific address or when specific memory is accessed. Essential for debugging game logic, input handling, and timing issues.

address.description: Memory address in hex format (e.g., '0x0083D7' for ALTTP's NMI_ReadJoypads routine)

type.description: Breakpoint type: 'execute' breaks when PC reaches address, 'read'/'write'/'access' break on memory access

description.description: Human-readable label for this breakpoint (e.g., 'NMI handler entry')

function_declarations.name: emulator-clear-breakpoint
function_declarations.description: Remove a breakpoint by ID

id.description: Breakpoint ID to remove (from list-breakpoints output)

function_declarations.name: emulator-list-breakpoints
function_declarations.description: List all active breakpoints with their addresses, types, hit counts, and states

function_declarations.name: emulator-step
function_declarations.description: Step the emulator forward by one or more CPU instructions and return the new CPU state

function_declarations.name: emulator-run
function_declarations.description: Run the emulator until a breakpoint is hit or for a specified number of frames

until_break.description: Run until breakpoint is hit (default: false)

frames.description: Number of frames to run (if not until_break)

function_declarations.name: emulator-pause
function_declarations.description: Pause emulator execution for inspection

function_declarations.name: emulator-reset
function_declarations.description: Reset the emulator to initial state (hard reset)

function_declarations.name: emulator-get-registers
function_declarations.description: Get current CPU register values (A, X, Y, PC, PB, DB, SP, flags) for debugging

function_declarations.name: emulator-get-metrics
function_declarations.description: Get emulator performance metrics including FPS, cycle count, audio queue status

function_declarations.name: dungeon-list-sprites
function_declarations.description: List all sprites in a specific dungeon or room

dungeon.description: Dungeon name (e.g., 'hyrule_castle', 'eastern_palace') or leave empty for all

function_declarations.name: dungeon-describe-room
function_declarations.description: Get detailed information about a specific dungeon room including sprites, chests, layout, and connections

function_declarations.name: overworld-find-tile
function_declarations.description: Find all locations where a specific tile16 ID appears in the overworld

tile_id.description: Tile16 ID to search for (hex format like '0x42' or decimal)

map_id.description: Specific overworld map to search (0-63, optional)

function_declarations.name: overworld-describe-map
function_declarations.description: Get detailed information about a specific overworld map including tile composition, warps, and sprites

map_id.description: Overworld map ID (0-63 for light/dark world)

function_declarations.name: overworld-list-warps
function_declarations.description: List all warp/entrance points for a specific overworld map

function_declarations.name: overworld-list-sprites
function_declarations.description: List all sprites placed on a specific overworld map

function_declarations.name: overworld-get-entrance
function_declarations.description: Get detailed information about a specific entrance/exit including destination and properties

function_declarations.name: overworld-tile-stats
function_declarations.description: Get statistical analysis of tile usage across overworld maps

map_id.description: Specific map ID or 'all' for global statistics

function_declarations.name: hex-read
function_declarations.description: Read bytes from ROM at a specific address in hexadecimal

function_declarations.name: hex-write
function_declarations.description: Write bytes to ROM at a specific address (creates a proposal)

data.description: Hex data to write (space-separated bytes like 'FF 00 12 34')

function_declarations.name: hex-search
function_declarations.description: Search for a byte pattern in ROM

pattern.description: Hex pattern to search (e.g., 'FF 00 ?? 12' where ?? is wildcard)

function_declarations.name: palette-get-colors
function_declarations.description: Preview colors from a named generic palette group; this command is read-only

group.description: Palette group name such as ow_main or dungeon_main

index.description: Optional palette index within the named group

function_declarations.name: dungeon-get-palette
function_declarations.description: Resolve a US/OOS room's full 8-bit palette-set ID to its shared global dungeon palette and list every affected room; unsupported regional layouts fail closed

index.description: Optional color index; omit to return all 90 colors

function_declarations.name: dungeon-set-palette-color
function_declarations.description: Dry-run or persist one US/OOS shared dungeon palette color with full palette-set, resolved-index, old-color, manifest, clean-file baseline, backup, atomic-save, and external-readback guards

index.description: Color index in the 90-color dungeon palette

expect-palette-index.description: Expected resolved global dungeon palette index

manifest.description: Hack Manifest path used to block protected ranges

write.description: Persist only after reviewing the default dry-run

function_declarations.name: palette-analyze
function_declarations.description: Analyze color usage and statistics for a palette or bitmap

function_declarations.name: todo-create
function_declarations.description: Create a new TODO task for complex operations

function_declarations.name: todo-list
function_declarations.description: List all TODO tasks or filter by status/category

function_declarations.name: todo-update-status
function_declarations.description: Update the status of a TODO task

function_declarations.name: todo-next
function_declarations.description: Get the next actionable TODO task (respecting dependencies and priority)
